_comment: FALLBACK goals only. The live dashboard reads targets from the Notion 'Company Goals' database (Metric Key -> Value) for the current Period; these values are used only if that row is missing or the Goals DB is unreachable. Quarter dates live here because the Goals DB stores values, not the calendar.
_dates_comment: EDIT THESE EACH QUARTER. baselineWeekStart = the Monday of the week we measure quarterly spread growth FROM (usually the week BEFORE the quarter). quarterStart/quarterEnd = the actual quarter window (Mon..Sun) used to count starts, pending, dump-in, meetings. The In/Out growth chart runs from baselineWeekStart through quarterEnd.

raffle._comment: Qualifying start = weekly spread >= threshold. Every batchSize qualifying STARTED placements triggers a drawing; AM + recruiter each earn 1 ticket per qualifying start (2 tickets/start).

dumpinCarryInExclusion._comment: RESET for Q4 2026 (was 21519 / 19 for Q3). Holds forms created in the opening days of the quarter, before the quarterly kickoff, that were already locked up last quarter — they are not part of this quarter's net-new go-get. Fill it in once the Q4 kickoff date is set and the pre-kickoff forms are known. REPLACE with a Notion tag on those records and filter in rebuild_queries.json.

_renewals_comment: Contractors the team confirmed will renew in Q4 — now the CURRENT quarter, so they are stripped from this quarter's Out bars (the filter runs on both quarters). Held out of the Out bars AND the rolling lock-up goal. Matching ignores the trailing ' / id' and quotes. Best fix is updating Actual End Date in Notion; clear names from here once that is done.
_unplanned_comment: Estimated early terminations not yet recorded in Notion. Applied to the current week forward only (past weeks already carry their actuals). 2026 actuals by quarter: Q1 1.09%/wk, Q2 0.66%, Q3 1.00% - blended 0.91%. Base = active contract Est Spread; refresh it each quarter (2026-09-28: 270 active rows, $294,156). Set rate to 0 to turn the amber segment off entirely.
